meta.title: Brand Identity
meta.subtitle: A calmer operating system for early teams

strategy.product: A decision log that turns scattered startup discussions into a visible operating memory.
strategy.audience: Founding teams of three to fifteen people making fast product decisions across chat, calls, and documents.
strategy.trigger: Repeated debates and unclear ownership start slowing the team down.
strategy.problem: Important decisions disappear into chat history and have to be reconstructed later.
strategy.alternatives: Chat search, meeting notes, project tools, and individual memory.
strategy.distinctive_value: Northstar captures the decision, rationale, owner, and revisit date in one lightweight record.
strategy.positioning: Northstar gives small startup teams a shared memory for decisions without turning every conversation into process.
strategy.promise: Every important decision remains understandable and actionable.
evidence_notes: Sample content used to validate the report generator.

territories.name: Visible Trail
territories.thesis: Every decision leaves a useful trail the team can follow.
territories.audience_response: We can move quickly without losing context.
territories.metaphor: A path marked by deliberate waypoints.
territories.voice_sample: Capture the call. Keep the reason.
territories.symbol: Three waypoints connected by one directional cut.

typography.display: A sturdy grotesk with compact headlines
typography.body: A highly readable neutral sans serif

territories.application: A product timeline where each decision appears as a visible waypoint.
territories.risk: Could feel like project management if the decision focus is not explicit.

territories.name: Quiet Signal
territories.thesis: Separate durable decisions from the noise surrounding them.
territories.audience_response: This gives our team clarity without more meetings.
territories.metaphor: A crisp signal emerging from soft interference.
territories.voice_sample: Keep the decision. Let the chatter go.
territories.symbol: One sharp vertical signal crossing three fading horizontal bands.

typography.display: A precise neo-grotesk with open counters

territories.application: A landing hero where one decision card stays sharp while surrounding messages blur.
territories.risk: The signal metaphor is common and needs a distinctive execution.

territories.name: Decision Gravity
territories.thesis: Important decisions should organize the work around them.
territories.audience_response: Our priorities and ownership will stop drifting.
territories.metaphor: A central force pulling related actions into orbit.
territories.voice_sample: One decision. Clear ownership. Less drift.
territories.symbol: A solid core with two offset orbital brackets.
territories.application: A pitch cover with one decision at the center and actions orbiting it.
territories.risk: The gravity language may sound heavy for a lightweight tool.

recommendation.reason: It connects the product mechanism to a clear, flexible visual behavior and remains understandable without explanation.
recommendation.tradeoff: It is less provocative than Decision Gravity, so copy and motion must preserve energy.

brand_system.one_liner: A shared memory for the decisions that move your startup.
brand_system.value_proposition: Capture what was decided, why, who owns it, and when to revisit it.
brand_system.logo_concept: Three rounded waypoints connected by a single forward path; the final point opens into an arrow-shaped cut.

typography.body: Neutral interface sans serif, regular to medium

voice_traits.meaning: Lead with the decision and remove ceremony.
voice_traits.do: Record the call while the reason is fresh.
voice_traits.dont: Leverage our framework to optimize decision capture.

voice_traits.do: You can revisit this in two weeks.
voice_traits.dont: Don't worry—we'll take care of everything.

voice_traits.meaning: Make the next action visible without adding bureaucracy.
voice_traits.do: Name an owner and keep moving.

message_pillars.title: Remember the why
message_pillars.message: Keep rationale attached to every important decision.

message_pillars.title: Keep ownership visible
message_pillars.message: Turn decisions into accountable next moves.

message_pillars.title: Revisit deliberately
message_pillars.message: Know which assumptions deserve another look.

brand_system.image_direction: Top-down working scenes with one luminous path connecting decision artifacts; natural texture, quiet light, no staged handshake imagery.
